mapper.select: SELECT * FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date = #{workDate} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_record(employee_id, work_date, check_in, check_out, break_minutes, status) VALUES(#{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{breakMinutes}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET check_in = #{checkIn}, check_out = #{checkOut}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
